arguments.summary: An APT intrusion was identified originating from host WS-FIN-042 (10.0.5.42), owned by user CORP\jsmith in the Finance department. The initial compromise occurred via a phishing email triggering a malicious PowerShell script that loaded a Cobalt Strike beacon from the Temp directory using rundll32.exe. The malware established C2 communication over HTTPS to 198.51.100.23. Indicators of lateral movement were observed, including failed Kerberos authentication attempts and successful SMB access to a file server (10.0.5.50). Although sandboxing returned clean results, EDR telemetry and IDS alerts confirm malicious activity. Immediate containment actions were denied due to policy restrictions.

timeline.description: Nmap SYN scan detected from 10.0.8.200 to 10.0.2.15. Also associated with user CORP\jsmith, though source IP differs.
Outlook.exe launched on WS-FIN-042 (10.0.5.42) under user CORP\jsmith.
Malicious PowerShell process spawned from Outlook with encoded command (T1566.001).
rundll32.exe executed unsigned beacon.dll from Temp directory (T1218.011).
IDS alert triggered: Cobalt Strike beacon C2 activity to 198.51.100.23 (T1071.001).
Failed Kerberos TGT request from WS-FIN-042, indicating potential credential brute-force or golden ticket use (T1558.001).
Successful SMB access from WS-FIN-042 to file server 10.0.5.50, confirming lateral movement (T1021.002).
Ongoing monitoring initiated for APT activity on segment 10.0.8.0/24. Incident formally escalated.

title: Suspicious PowerShell Launched from Office Application
logsource:

    product: windows
detection:
    selection:

        Image|endswith: '\\powershell.exe'
        CommandLine|contains: '-enc'

level: high

rule CobaltStrike_Beacon_Dynamic_Loader {
    meta:
        description = "Detects dynamic loading of Cobalt Strike beacons via rundll32 from temp directories"
        author = "SOC Team"
        reference = "MITRE ATT&CK T1218.011, T1071.001"
        date = "2026-04-11"
    strings:
        $dll_load = /rundll32\.exe .*\\AppData\\Local\\Temp\\[a-zA-Z0-9]{6,}\.dll,Start/
        $c2_beacon = /GET \/[a-zA-Z0-9]{4,} HTTP\/1\.1/ wide ascii
    condition:
        $dll_load and $c2_beacon
}
